models.name: RPS-42 radar panel (RADA MHR)

models.name: IRIS counter-drone radar (Robin)

models.name: RfOne Mk2 RF sensor (DroneShield)

models.name: RF-360 passive RF sensor (Dedrone)

models.name: HELIOS 60 kW shipboard laser

Fires from a static emplacement and degrades badly in cloud, fog and low visibility, which is why Iron Dome remains the all-weather layer.

models.name: CUAEWS DF (SRC, LIDS EW)
